label: Raritan EMX2-888 smart rack controller
description: 1U environmental rack controller with eight RJ-12 sensor ports (temperature, humidity, air flow, differential pressure, water-leak and contact-closure sensors), eight RJ-45 asset-management feature ports, eight RS-485 ports, two contact closures and a 10/100BASE-T Ethernet port plus a DB-9 console/modem port, feeding sensor data to Power IQ or any SNMP manager.
notes: Datasheet model table: 'EMX2-888 Smart rack controller with 8 RJ-12 sensor ports, 8 RJ-45 feature ports for AMS, 8 RJ-45 RS-485 ports, 2 USB-A ports, 1 USB-B port, 1 RJ-45 Ethernet port, 1 DB-9M console/modem, 2 contact closure, LCD display'. The RJ-45 feature ports are Raritan's asset-management sensor bus and the RJ-45 RS-485 ports are serial field buses - neither is Ethernet, so only the single RJ-45 Ethernet port is modelled. Fast Ethernet is confirmed by the EMX user guide (Xerus 3.6.0) LED description: 'Yellow indicates communications at 10/100 BaseT speeds'. Supports up to 128 sensors across the ports; SNMPv1/v2/v3, Power IQ integration.
